passages.text: A small garden stands in the centre of our town, with streets on every side. Mia is interested in the plants there and wants to learn their names. She asks the gardener whether the reading club can help make simple labels. The gardener agrees and checks each name before the pupils write it neatly. Ben adds small drawings so visitors can match the labels to the plants. The project turns Mia's curiosity into something useful for everyone who visits.

parallelText.en: A small garden stands in the centre of our town, with streets on every side.
parallelText.zh: 小花园位于我们镇的中心，四周都是街道。

parallelText.en: Mia is interested in the plants there and wants to learn their names.
parallelText.zh: 米娅对那里的植物感兴趣，想学会它们的名字。

parallelText.en: She asks the gardener whether the reading club can help make simple labels.
parallelText.zh: 她问园丁，阅读社团能否帮忙制作简单标牌。

parallelText.en: The gardener agrees and checks each name before the pupils write it neatly.
parallelText.zh: 园丁同意了，并在学生工整写字前逐一核对名称。

parallelText.en: Ben adds small drawings so visitors can match the labels to the plants.
parallelText.zh: 本加上小图，让访客能把标牌与植物对应起来。

parallelText.en: The project turns Mia's curiosity into something useful for everyone who visits.
parallelText.zh: 这个项目把米娅的好奇心变成所有访客都能用到的东西。

passages.text: The old bridge is a tourist spot that many families visit at weekends. Our town puts small lamps beside the path to light up the bridge after dark. Mia visits with her grandfather and compares the evening view with a daytime photograph. The shape is the same, but the lamps make the stone lines easier to see. Grandfather points out a seat where they can rest without blocking the path. They sit and draw the bridge before walking home together. Mia discovers that returning to a familiar place at a new time can change what she notices.

parallelText.en: The old bridge is a tourist spot that many families visit at weekends.
parallelText.zh: 这座老桥是许多家庭周末游览的旅游景点。

parallelText.en: Our town puts small lamps beside the path to light up the bridge after dark.
parallelText.zh: 我们镇在路旁设小灯，天黑后照亮桥。

parallelText.en: Mia visits with her grandfather and compares the evening view with a daytime photograph.
parallelText.zh: 米娅和爷爷来游览，把晚景与白天的照片比较。

parallelText.en: The shape is the same, but the lamps make the stone lines easier to see.
parallelText.zh: 形状相同，但灯让石头线条更容易看清。

parallelText.en: Grandfather points out a seat where they can rest without blocking the path.
parallelText.zh: 爷爷指出一个可以休息又不挡路的座位。

parallelText.en: They sit and draw the bridge before walking home together.
parallelText.zh: 他们坐着画桥，然后一起步行回家。

parallelText.en: Mia discovers that returning to a familiar place at a new time can change what she notices.
parallelText.zh: 米娅发现，在不同时段重返熟悉的地方，可以注意到不同细节。

wordHelp.meaning: stopping people or things from passing
